title: Man in Overalls Outdoors, 1948 B&W Snapshot, Rural USA
description: A full-length black and white snapshot of an elderly man standing outdoors in work overalls, a dark cardigan sweater, and a cap. Behind him is a wooden outbuilding and an open garage revealing the back of a vintage automobile. Hand-dated May 9, 1948 on the reverse, offering an authentic depiction of mid-20th-century rural working-class life in America.
